releaseInfo.releaseNotes:
Hypergamous Tree Chopping Simulator 4 - 1.4.0

- ENCHANTING TABLE in every camp: Sharpness, Swiftness, Fortune, Lifesteal and Bossbane for the axe you are holding. Enchanted axes shimmer purple.
- SELL AXES: sell old axes back for half what they cost (Reaper, Forge, Moonforge and Crucible).
- GHOST LUMBERJACKS now work on every island. Past Pine Island they haul back materials.
- CHRISTMAS TREES on every island: Christmas Pine, Frosted Christmas Fir, Starlight Spruce and Yule Ember Tree. Fell one and a present falls out.
- +50 MAX HEALTH for every rebirth.
- WILDLIFE everywhere: mountain goats, marmots and hunting eagles on the Highland Isle; moon foxes, shroomlings, glowing snails and lantern moths on Mooncap; salamanders, ember beetles, ash crows and bats on Ashfall; squirrels on Pine Island. Fireflies at night.
- DECORATIONS on every island: mushrooms, fallen logs, berry bushes, cairns, fairy rings, crystals, obsidian, lava cracks and more.
